title: Separate direct provider valuation from modeled valuation candidates
objective: Prevent exact provider prices and modeled C/D estimates from sharing ambiguous candidate semantics or EV totals.
changes: Tier B candidates now carry valuation_class=direct-provider, direct_market_observation=true and modeled_value=false.
Tier C/D candidates now carry valuation_class=modeled, direct_market_observation=false and modeled_value=true.
Every candidate exposes evidence_breakdown with realized-sale and exact-provider observation counts.
Candidate summary now separates direct-provider EV from modeled EV and labels the combined total explicitly non-canonical.
The ambiguous candidate_ev_total_usd summary field is removed.
A CI regression test enforces the separation contract.
guarantees: No automated candidate becomes canonical EV.
Tier B remains current provider evidence, not a realized sale.
Tier C/D remain modeled estimates even when their supporting evidence includes direct observations.
Tier E remains unknown with null market value and null EV.
